summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The AllianzIM International Equity Buffer15 Uncapped Apr ETF (ARLI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in enhanced growth alternatives. The fund seeks to track international developed equity price returns with a 15% downside buffer over a defined outcome period from April 1, 2026, to March 31, 2027. The fund uses options to limit losses within the buffer while participating in gains above a set threshold. ARLI was launched on Mar 31, 2026 and is issued by Allianz.
